anomalies.description: A police officer in riot gear physically strikes and pushes a person wearing a yellow vest who is on the ground, while another individual in civilian clothing (with helmet and baton) stands nearby observing; the victim is clearly helpless and not resisting.

Ongoing violent unrest involving multiple riot police officers and civilians in a public square; smoke/haze present, officers advance with shields and batons, individuals are being subdued or lying on ground, consistent with a large-scale confrontation.

Multiple individuals in riot gear engage in physical contact with civilians on the ground; at f3–f4, one officer pulls a person by the arm while another approaches with baton, suggesting mutual or multi-party physical struggle during arrest/subduing.

Ongoing violent unrest involving multiple riot police officers and civilians in an urban street setting, with smoke, aggressive postures, shields, batons, and physical confrontation around a detained individual; consistent with collective violent disorder beyond peaceful protest.

A person wearing a yellow vest is on the ground, visibly restrained and struck by multiple police officers in riot gear and by a civilian in a black jacket with 'POLICE' on the back; the victim appears helpless and does not resist while being kicked, pushed, and held down.

Ongoing violent unrest: multiple riot police in full gear engage with protesters on a city street; smoke/tear gas visible, crowd movement suggests confrontation, and a protester is subdued on the ground amid active police deployment.

A person wearing a yellow vest is on the ground, surrounded and physically restrained by multiple police officers in riot gear; officers are seen pulling, dragging, and holding the individual down over several seconds.

A person wearing a yellow vest is on the ground, surrounded by multiple riot police officers in full gear who are actively engaging with them—some holding shields over the individual, one appears to be striking or pressing down, and others are positioned to restrain. The individual is in a vulnerable, prone position with no apparent ability to resist, indicating abuse of a helpless victim.; A police officer in riot gear is seen striking or pressing a large shield against a person lying on the ground who appears incapacitated and defenseless, while other officers surround them.

Ongoing violent unrest involving multiple riot police and civilians in a street setting: officers in protective gear advance with shields, deploy what appears to be tear gas or smoke (visible haze), and engage individuals; background shows dispersed crowd, some fleeing, and chaotic movement consistent with a riot. The scene includes active confrontation, use of force, and disorder beyond peaceful protest.

In frames f12–f15, a woman in civilian clothing is physically engaged by at least two officers: one grabs her arm while another appears to push or strike her; she raises her hands defensively and recoils, indicating mutual physical struggle—not passive restraint. This constitutes fighting as it involves active resistance and reciprocal physical contact.

A police officer in helmet and vest grabs a woman wearing a yellow vest by the arm and appears to deploy a chemical irritant (visible white cloud near her face) while she is not resisting; she recoils with hands raised in distress.

A police officer in riot gear appears to strike or forcefully push a woman wearing a yellow vest, who is visibly recoiling and raising her hands defensively; the interaction is non-consensual and one-sided, with the woman not resisting physically.

Multiple uniformed officers in riot gear confront a group of civilians (including at least one yellow-vested individual) on a street, with physical contact and use of shields; background shows other individuals in similar attire and vehicles, indicating collective unrest and violent group confrontation.
